question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The teacher said, “Asif, go and wash your hands.”

options.text: The teacher told Asif go and wash your hands.
The teacher told Asif go and wash his hands.
The teacher told to Asif to go and wash his hands.
The teacher told Asif to go and wash his hands.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The teacher told Asif to go and wash his hands.'**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of an imperative sentence.
 
• Let's look at the rules of transformation:
 
• While changing the narration of an **imperative sentence**, we need to follow the given steps:
 
 
• The notion of the given sentence is '**suggestion**'.
 
• The conjunction '**to**' should be used in place of** a comma **(,) and** inverted commas **(“ ”). '**said**' will be changed into '**told**'.
 
• '**to**' is followed by '**V₁**'.
 
• '**your**' will be changed into '**his**' because **second-person pronouns** are changed according to the **object** of the **reporting verb.**
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *The queen said to his servant, "Cook me some delicious food today." (Direct Speech)*
 
• *The queen ordered his servant to cook her some delicious food that day. (Indirect Speech)*

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ The teacher told Asif to go and wash his hands.*
